title: repo-analyst prior-run review
description: A bounded review of completed runs, with cited run and source evidence and one recommended next action.

summary.description: What the reviewed runs did and where they went wrong.

findings.description: Recurring findings. A finding seen in exactly one run is still reported, with occurrences of 1, so a reader can tell an isolated defect from a pattern.

finding.description: The generalized behavior, not the individual symptom.

occurrences.description: How many reviewed runs exhibited it.

evidence.description: Run or source evidence supporting this finding.

snapshot_hash.description: Snapshot hash carried by the result that produced this evidence.

resource.description: Run ID for private-history, or relative path for workspace.

positions.description: Positive positions in the cited provider snapshot: event or inspection-record sequence IDs for private-history, or source line numbers for workspace.

recommended_next_action.description: The single next action a maintainer should take. Recommending no action is a valid review outcome.

rationale.description: Why that action follows from the cited evidence.
